note: Ruelle des Gourmets place 3/3; landmark: giant glass carafe house; the green iron-and-glass market dome at the far end (destination). Restyled to match the street (cartoony 2.5, white plaster, neutral light); the lane ends at the green market dome of the Place du Marché. Friends clink glasses of lemonade. Last place: the far end shows the destination. No -er/-ir markers, no painted text.
